name: Operator
tagline: One daily brief for founders, in place of forty open tabs
description: Opens with a handful of quick either-or questions so it learns the way you want it run. From then on it takes whatever loose notes have piled up, works them into a single written brief, and hands back an ordered list of the decisions genuinely waiting on you.
author: mjjefford
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
